text:
Alex: hey team — quick planning thread for the mini launch sprint. goal: ship 2 short tutorials, one reference app walkthrough, an open-source launch note, a concise benchmark narrative, and a 30-min webinar seed this week. who takes what?
Priya: I can handle the two tutorials. thinking 7-9 minutes each: developer quickstart (local) and dedicated deploy how-to. will make captions and short CLI snippets.
Sam: I will update the refapp and write the OSS post. will reuse last hackday refapp but tighten README and add a one-click start badge.
Olivia: I will draft the benchmark story and webinar outline. focus: real-world latency and cost comparisons between hosted API and dedicated pools, with reproducible commands.
Alex: timeline idea: first drafts by Monday EOD, internal review Tuesday morning, publish Thursday AM. doable?
Priya: Monday AM recording works. need final script by Sunday night for captions.
Sam: refapp integration tests will run tonight, OSS post draft by Monday. adding form for inbound routing into the demo page.
Olivia: webinar outline and slides draft Monday afternoon. prefer a Wed dry run.
Alex: inbound lead routing plan: add a dropdown on signup with options demo / contribute / benchmark. route using org size and choice: demo -> sales-enterprise if >250, else sales-selfserve; contribute -> devrel; benchmark -> product-marketing; fallback -> growth.
Sam: adding dropdown + utm param campaign=mini-ecosystem to the refapp signup. will update CI to validate form fields.
Priya: promo plan: short tweet thread, LinkedIn post, GH discussion starter. copy idea: Run the Redwood mini-refapp locally in 5 mins, see benchmark numbers.
Olivia: email seed copy draft with two subject lines: 1) Run our refapp locally and compare costs 2) Hands-on: deploy a refapp in 5 minutes (bench numbers included).
Alex: analytics events we need: refapp_started, form_submitted, webinar_rsvp. ensure frontend emits these with org_size and campaign props.
Priya: landing page will include a single-command sample: git clone repo && ./start-local.sh --model redwood-1b. will link the tutorial videos and badge.
Sam: README will have a Try Locally badge linking to the tutorial and the signup form.
Olivia: benchmark PR will include commands and expected outputs so readers can reproduce numbers. also include cost assumptions (GPU type, token pricing).
Alex: roles recap: Priya tutorials + landing; Sam refapp + OSS post + form; Olivia benchmark + webinar + email; Alex promo cadence + deadlines.
Priya: review checklist request: README sanity, captions, CI runbook, form routing smoke test.
Sam: will add CI test for query params and utm.
post-bot: reminder scheduled for #marketing review on Tue 10:00 AM (automated).
Alex: great. aim to publish Thursday morning PST. if anyone hits a blocker ping here. :rocket:
